capabilities: Export decks to html, pdf, pptx, and images
Apply custom theme CSS to slides
extras: README is thin and mostly points to external Marp documentation for how to write slides; the mobile app version is stated to be in Alpha; Wiki Links are not supported; non-HTML export needs a locally installed Chromium-based browser (configurable via CHROME_PATH).
intentEvidence: Marp Slides is very simple & powerful slide deck extension for Obsidian based on Marp.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for the Marp Markdown slide format or for exporting decks to HTML, PDF, PPTX, and images.

relations.evidence: Marp Slides is very simple & powerful slide deck extension for Obsidian based on Marp.

requires.name: Google Chrome, Chromium, or Microsoft Edge

summary: Marp-based slide extension that previews, presents, and exports Markdown slide decks from Obsidian notes.
